name: Visa-free entry
summary: Citizens of many countries can enter without a visa, usually for up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Some get less, like 30 days for Thailand and 60 days for Russia. Check the official list for your passport.

other: Depends on your passport. See the official list on the Foreign Ministry page.
Passport must be valid at least 60 days past your authorized stay. The ministry advises 6 months of validity.
Medical insurance for the full stay is required for visa applicants, and a visa does not guarantee entry.

stay.note: Most common rule. Shorter for some: 30 days (Brunei, Thailand, Indonesia per entry), 60 days (Russia), Belarus 30 days per trip and 90 per year.

sources.label: Foreign Ministry: visa information for foreigners
Foreign Ministry: general information about Turkish visas

name: e-Visa (tourism or commerce)
summary: If your passport needs a visa, you can often apply online at evisa.gov.tr in about three minutes. It only works for tourism or commerce. Some nationalities qualify only if they hold a valid Schengen, US, UK or Irish visa or residence permit.

other: Only valid for tourism or commerce. Work and study need a visa from a Turkish mission.
Some nationalities must hold a valid Schengen, US, UK or Irish visa or residence permit, and some have age or airline limits. Check the e-Visa site for your passport.
Passport must be valid at least 60 days past your authorized stay.
Fee amounts were not on the pages read. They are on the e-Visa site.

stay.note: Length depends on nationality. Stays are capped at 90 days in any 180-day period.

steps: Go to evisa.gov.tr
Enter your passport details and pick your nationality
Pay online by card
Print or save the e-Visa
processing: The Foreign Ministry says the online application takes about three minutes.

sources.label: Foreign Ministry: visa information for foreigners
Official e-Visa portal

name: Visa from a Turkish embassy or consulate
summary: If you can't use visa-free entry or an e-Visa, or you want to work, study or join family, you apply at a Turkish mission. Consulates issue visas for up to 90 days. Longer stays need a residence permit.

other: Visa types include tourist, business, student and internship, work, family unification, medical treatment and more.
Apply at least one month before travel.
Medical insurance valid for the full stay is required.
Applicants under 18 need written approval from both parents, with exceptions for divorce or a deceased parent.
Fees were not listed on the pages read.

stay.note: Visas are issued for up to 90 days. Residence permits are canceled if you spend more than 120 days outside Türkiye in a year.

steps: Apply at a Turkish mission or through the pre-application system linked on the Foreign Ministry page
Submit your documents
Register with the local police if you stay to live, work or study

name: Transit visa (single or double)
summary: Single and double transit are listed visa types for people who need a visa. Airside transit rules were not on the pages I could read, so check with a Turkish mission before booking.

other: Many visa exemptions also cover transit.
Airside transit visa rules not confirmed from an official page.

sources.label: Foreign Ministry: general information about Turkish visas

name: Harbor city entry from naval ports
summary: Travelers arriving at some sea ports can visit the port city without a visa for up to 72 hours. You get a Harbor City Entry Permit and must return it when you leave. It is not a visa.

other: Sightseeing near the port only.
The permit must be returned on exit.

sources.label: Foreign Ministry: general information about Turkish visas

name: Short-term residence permit
summary: You need this if you want to stay more than 90 days or longer than your visa or visa exemption. It is generally issued for up to two years. You apply in the e-residence system, then submit documents at the provincial migration office.

other: Needed if you stay over 90 days, overstay a visa, or are visa-exempt and want to stay longer.
You must show proof of sufficient financial means and have health insurance. The amount was not on the pages read.
Official page is marked as a test version. Check e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr for current rules and fees.
Turkey has no official digital nomad visa that I could confirm.

stay.note: Generally up to two years. Apply for extension up to 60 days before expiry.

steps: Fill in the form in the e-residence system (e-ikamet)
Gather documents: passport copy, four biometric photos, proof of financial means, fee receipts, health insurance, title deed if you own property
Attend your appointment at the Provincial Directorate of Migration Management
documents: Title deed if you own property in Türkiye

Foreign Ministry: general information about Turkish visas

name: Fixed-term work permit
summary: You get a work permit for one specific job with one employer. You apply for a work visa at a Turkish mission, and your employer files with the Ministry of Labour. The first permit is up to one year.

other: Employer submits documents to the Ministry of Labour within 10 working days.
The ministry decides within 30 days at most.
A work annotated visa lets you enter for up to 90 days.
Register with local police within one month of arrival to get a residence permit.
Some short-term activities are exempt from work permits under Article 55 of Law No. 4817.

stay.note: First permit up to 1 year. First extension up to 2 years. Later extensions up to 3 years, with the same employer. A new employer counts as a first application.

steps: Apply for a work visa and permit at the nearest Turkish mission with your passport, visa form and employer letter
Your employer files documents with the Ministry of Labour and Social Security
Enter with the work annotated visa
Register with local police within one month and get a residence permit
processing: Ministry decision within 30 days of the employer filing.

name: Permanent work permit
summary: For people with a long-term residence permit or at least eight years of legal work in Türkiye. Holders get long-term residence rights and most citizen rights, but can't vote or hold public office.

other: Long-term residence permit, or a legal work permit held for at least 8 years.
Approval is not guaranteed.
Holders have no military service duty.

stay.note: Renewed every five years from the start date. Apply within six months before the five years end.

sources.label: Ministry of Labour: work permit types
Ministry of Labour: 2026 work permit fees

name: Independent work permit
summary: Lets you work on your own account in Türkiye without being tied to an employer. It is issued for a set period. The ministry looks at education, experience, impact on the economy and jobs, and your capital share if you own a company.

other: Judged on education level, professional experience, contribution to science and technology, impact on the economy and employment, and capital share.
Specific minimum requirements were not on the page read.

sources.label: Ministry of Labour: work permit types
Ministry of Labour: 2026 work permit fees

name: Turquoise Card
summary: For highly skilled people, investors and other standouts. It starts with a three-year provisional period, then you apply to remove the provisional status. Holders get the rights of a permanent work permit, and spouse and children get a document that works as a residence permit.

other: Based on education, experience, contribution to science and technology, investment or export levels, jobs created, and international cultural, artistic or sports success.
Assessed against Ministry procedures and an advisory board.
People under temporary protection can't apply.
Apply to remove provisional status within the 180 days before the three years end, or the card becomes invalid.

Ministry of Labour: work permit types

name: Student residence permit
summary: Foreign students get a residence permit for the length of their study. First, get a student visa from a Turkish mission, then apply for the permit in the e-residence system.

other: Need a student certificate or Foreign Student Information Form, health insurance, address proof and a declaration of sufficient financial means.
Passport valid 60 days longer than the permit period.
Student visas come from Turkish missions, not the e-Visa.

stay.note: Issued for the study period. Extended yearly if you can't graduate on time, up to the maximum study period.

steps: Fill in the form in the e-residence system
Gather documents
Attend your appointment at the Provincial Immigration Administration Directorate before your visa expires
documents: Student certificate or Foreign Student Information Form
processing: Finalized within 90 days at the latest.

name: Family residence permit
summary: For spouses and children of a Turkish citizen or a foreigner living in Türkiye. The sponsor must attend, show regular income, and cover everyone with health insurance. The amount of income was not listed.

other: Marriage certificate with notarized Turkish translation and apostille.
Sponsor must show sufficient and regular income. Amount not specified on the page read.
Health insurance for all family members for the full permit period.
Proof of accommodation: title deed, notarized lease, or notarized host statement.
Child applicants need a birth certificate and custody or parental consent papers where relevant.

steps: Apply in the e-residence system
Sponsor and applicant attend the appointment with documents
documents: Criminal record if sponsor hasn't lived in Türkiye for 5 years

sources.label: e-Residence: documents for family residence permit

name: Investor residence permit (up to 5 years)
summary: Investors who meet the government's thresholds can get a short-term residence permit of up to five years, extended to spouse and children. Qualifying routes include USD 500,000 in fixed capital, a USD 400,000 property with a three-year resale limit, or jobs for 50 people.

investment.note: Property route minimum. Other routes are USD 500,000 or 50 jobs.

other: Seven qualifying options per the Invest in Türkiye page.
Page is marked as a test version. Confirm current thresholds before relying on this.

sources.label: Invest in Türkiye: obtaining a residence permit

name: Long-term residence permit
summary: After eight years of continuous residence you can get a long-term permit. It is issued indefinitely, so no extension is needed.

other: At least 8 years of continuous residence in Türkiye.
No social aid received in the last three years.
Proof of financial means, police record and health insurance.

documents: Proof of no social aid in last 3 years

sources.label: Invest in Türkiye: obtaining a residence permit

name: Citizenship by general naturalization
summary: You can apply after five years of uninterrupted residence in Türkiye. You need good Turkish, good moral character and no disease that is a general health hazard. Approval is discretionary.

other: 5 years of uninterrupted residence.
Good moral character.
No disease posing a general health hazard.
Dual citizenship rules were not on the pages read.

citizenship.note: Dual citizenship rules not confirmed from an official page. Contact NVI or call 199.

name: Citizenship by marriage
summary: You can apply after three years of marriage to a Turkish citizen, if the marriage is still ongoing.

other: Married to a Turkish citizen for at least 3 years and the marriage continues.
Approval is discretionary.
Dual citizenship rules not confirmed from an official page.

citizenship.note: Dual citizenship rules not confirmed from an official page.

sources.label: Presidency of Migration Management: acquisition of Turkish citizenship

name: Citizenship by descent
summary: A child is a Turkish citizen at birth if at least one parent is a Turkish citizen. Türkiye does not grant citizenship just for being born there. Adults with a Turkish parent who weren't registered before 18 may still register if the ministry confirms they acquired citizenship.

other: At least one Turkish parent.
Being born in Türkiye alone does not give citizenship.

citizenship.note: Generations limit not stated on the page read.

sources.label: Presidency of Migration Management: acquisition of Turkish citizenship

name: Citizenship by investment
summary: Exceptional citizenship for investors, decided by the President. Options include USD 500,000 fixed capital, a USD 400,000 property held three years, a USD 500,000 deposit, bonds or fund shares held three years, or jobs for 50 people. A spouse and minor children can apply together.

investment.note: Property route with three-year resale ban. Other routes are USD 500,000 held at least 3 years, fixed capital, or 50 jobs.

other: Certificate of eligibility from the relevant ministry or agency.
Security and public order check.
Older Migration Management brochure lists a USD 250,000 property route. Invest in Türkiye lists USD 400,000. Confirm the current figure.

citizenship.note: Dual citizenship rules not confirmed from an official page.

steps: Get a certificate of eligibility from the relevant authority
Get a residence permit under Article 31(j) of Law No. 6458
Apply through the provincial migration and census offices
Security check, then the Presidency decides
